name: source-tab-code-action
goal: Every catalog opens details without a code action; only the detail Source tab offers View code in a revision-specific modal.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: User correction: code belongs only inside entity Source tabs, opened in the existing modal; no actions on catalogs or detail headers.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Reports entity-preview-source and Desktop entity-source-code scenarios previously required catalog/header actions. Strengthened the same category/viewport scenarios and card assertions to constrain entry point, lazy modal rendering, focus, revision and failures.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 2b8b5dac fails on catalog View code actions: expected zero, received one. Reports and Desktop standard scenarios and concise-card assertions fail on existing placement. Immutable record f73a49558af7963a044e863ab15a693e8af8f128608025253b132e5fb56caa5b.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Moved existing actions into Reports and Desktop Source panels, removed catalog/header actions and inline readers. All 24 Reports source cases and four Desktop source cases pass. Final test-only failing checkpoint c42b186b, record aa5764e06be8e73569962b00a830b6e043d5377ce595e9315ba1ad6609284ec2, preserves the same assertions after the lint-only extraction.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged proof passes at product 9d465581 against test-only c42b186b. Reports catalog/Source scenario, card/detail contracts and Desktop modal/focus/revision scenario pass with the frozen command and environment. Green record 140aa80f48b990a05922fd25377390316c21df80767f443fbefab7776d547a36.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Required root check at 66fb79fe failed only the concurrent-report package case: synthetic history did not seed within 180 seconds. An unchanged isolated retry failed at the second history deadline. Reports and Desktop complete checks and 55 affected browser cases pass. See the feature specification for exact commands, revisions, measurements and the open boundary.
